summary: Under --restricted on Claude Code 2.1.269, when --tools names Bash the Bash tool exists and its allow list is enforced: the session reported its tool set as 'Agent, Bash, Edit, Glob, Grep, Read, Write', ran the allow-listed 'git --version' (output 'git version 2.55.0'), and had the unlisted 'curl --version' denied automatically with the runtime's own no-approval-surface message. The relative in-root read succeeded.
establishes: P15's first half and the precondition of D7: the #138 frozen primary launch shape runs as written on this runtime. A shell allow list does exist under the restriction flag, so neither of D7's candidate routes has to be taken and the study is not stopped by gap-9's Bash hazard. It also re-establishes P05 (an unlisted command is denied automatically with no approval surface in a non-interactive session) inside the frozen shape.
residual: This says nothing about what an allow-listed interpreter can reach - that is P13, still audited and not enforced. It also does not establish the launch shape for the finder, which carries no shell at all.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
